facility.name: Rainbow Shine Daycare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During an inspection on 9/29/2026, a caregiver was present with children without the correct background being conducted. The person is an assistant caregiver, which requires fingerprints to be completed. However, their background check was run as a volunteer which does not require fingerprints.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: The operation was not in compliance with the child/caregiver ratio. There were 12 children in care and the ratio was 1 caregiver to 8 children. This was corrected when 4 children went home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The menu does not meet the U.S. Department of Agriculture nutritional guidelines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §747.3101(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operation did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver created one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational policy for parent's rights did not include all of the required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: The water hose was seen across the backyard during inspection. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.4815(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: This standard was re-cited. 5 children files were reviewed for compliance at the follow up and were missing the following items:  1 file was missing the immunization, 1 file was missing the health statements from the doctor
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Set Up During Other Activities: During inspection the nap mats were set up prior to nap time and before lunch time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Set Up During Other Activities (26 TAC §747.2809(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: This standard was re-cited. 18 children files were reviewed for compliance at the follow up and were missing the following items:  2 files were missing the immunization, 5 files were missing the health statements from the doctor, 1 file was missing the parent signature on the allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: This standard was re-cited. 18 children files reviewed for compliance the following items were missing: 1 file was m issing the signature from the parent on the emergency medical authorization. 1 file was missing the Emergency Medical Authorization address for the doctor or the hospital.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 18 children files were reviewed and were missing the following items:  7 files were missing the immunization, 9 files were missing the health statements from the doctor, 2 files were missing the doctor stamp or signature on the immunizations, 1 file was missing the allergy alert plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Household Members Qualifications - Household Member Left in Charge Must Meet Caregiver Qualifications: The household member did not have proof of orientation. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Household Members Qualifications - Household Member Left in Charge Must Meet Caregiver Qualifications (26 TAC §747.1401(d))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: The child care home had 13 children present and the capacity of the home is 12 children. Four children left during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): The staff files were reviewed and two files were missing the 2912. One file was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.1207(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: There was a piece of play equipment that was broken that was observed in the backyard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §747.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: A child was observed being placed in a high chair that did not have safety straps. The child was removed from the high chair at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §747.4301(b))

occurrences.finding: Orientation Required for Caregivers-Overview of Minimum Standards: The primary caregiver did not have documentation of orientation. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Orientation Required for Caregivers-Overview of Minimum Standards (26 TAC §747.1301(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation for Primary Caregivers of Licensed Home - Personal History Statement: The primary caregiver did not have proof of drivers license in the file at inspection. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation for Primary Caregivers of Licensed Home - Personal History Statement (26 TAC §747.1131(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Out of 18 children files reviewed the following items were missing: 4 files were missing emergency contact information, 2 files were missing field trip consent, 8 files were missing operational policies, 2 file was missing meals, 2 files were missing the days of attendance, 4 files were missing the food allergies, 2 files were missing the school information, 5 files were missing the emergency medical attention, 1 file was missing the final signature, 2 files were missing the date of birth, 2 files were missing the date of admission, 1 file was missing the parent name, 1 file was missing the parent rights, 1 file was missing the release of children,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: The water hose used for watering plants was within the children's reach during inspection. This was removed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.4815(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The parent handbook was reviewed. The following items were missing: Active play, parenental visitation, how parents can contact the local Child Care Regulation office phone number, the emergency Preparedness plan did not have the address of the relocation sight.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: There was a volunteer present that did not have an eligible background. This volunteer left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Three children did not have completed admission forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation: While trying to inspect the home, a household member was preventing the home from being fully inspected by holding the garage door shut.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation (26 TAC §745.8411(a))

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: The operation completed a child admission information form for a child that they claimed was their own child. It was later discovered this child was not their own child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules (26 TAC §747.207(9))

occurrences.finding: Allow Parents to Visit Child-care Home Anytime During Hours of Operation: During the investigation it was found that parents are not allowed inside the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Allow Parents to Visit Child-care Home Anytime During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.207(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: The child care home had 15 children present while the capacity of the home is 12 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation failed to demonstrate good judgement when they did not correct their eldest child when the child told Child Care Regulation the child had 3 siblings. The child's parent immediately terminated the conversation between the eldest child and Child Care Regulation. During the course of the investigation, it was determined the child had one sibling.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: Child Care Regulation was not notified prior to the operation transporting children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §747.301(6))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care: Child Care Regulation was not notified prior to school age children being cared for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §747.301(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies were missing the following statements: promotion of active play, medication procedures, medical emergencies, discipline/guidance, review of the minimum standard inspection report, how to contact licensing, the hotline, and HHSC website, and the emergency prepardness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The operation had the incorrect fire extinguisher. The operation had a 1-A: 10 BC rather than the required 3A 40BC model.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)
